arxiv-2107-02131.title: Local Statistics for Zeros of Artin-Schreier L L -functions
arxiv-2107-02131.creator: Alexei Entin, Noam Pirani
arxiv-2107-02131.description: Abstract We study the local statistics of zeros of L L -functions attached to Artin-Scheier curves over finite fields. We consider three families of Artin-Schreier L L -functions: the ordinary, polynomial (the p p -rank 0 stratum) and odd-polynomial families.

arxiv-2109-03347.title: Exploring tidal obliquity variations with SMERCURY-T Journal: PSJ
arxiv-2109-03347.creator: Steven M. Kreyche, Jason W. Barnes, Billy L. Quarles, John E. Chambers
arxiv-2109-03347.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Steven M. Kreyche, Jason W. Barnes, Billy L. Quarles, John E. Chambers. We introduce our new code, SMERCURY-T , which is based on existing codes SMERCURY ( Lissauer et al. 2012 ) and Mercury-T ( Bolmont et al. The result is a mixed-variable symplectic N-body integrator that can compute the orbital and spin evolution of a planet within a multi-planet system under the influence of tidal spin torques from its star.

arxiv-2208-12800.title: Unified theory of spin and charge in a ferromagnet Journal: J. Phys.: Condens. Matter
arxiv-2208-12800.creator: Oleg Tchernyshyov
arxiv-2208-12800.description: Abstract We derive a unified theory of spin and charge degrees of freedom in a ferromagnet. The spin-transfer torque and spin electromotive force are examined from the coarse-grained perspective of collective coordinates. The resulting equations of motion reflect a balance of conservative, gyroscopic (Berry-phase), and dissipative forces. We then expand the space of collective coordinates by adding the electric charge.

arxiv-2302-05740.title: UGAE: A Novel Approach to Non-exponential Discounting
arxiv-2302-05740.creator: Ariel Kwiatkowski ariel.kwiatkowski@polytechnique.edu, Vicky Kalogeiton vicky.kalogeiton@lix.polytechnique.fr, Julien Pettré julien.pettre@polytechnique.edu, Marie-Paule Cani marie-paule.cani@polytechnique.edu
arxiv-2302-05740.description: Abstract The discounting mechanism in Reinforcement Learning determines the relative importance of future and present rewards. While exponential discounting is widely used in practice, non-exponential discounting methods that align with human behavior are often desirable for creating human-like agents. However, non-exponential discounting methods cannot be directly applied in modern on-policy actor-critic algorithms.

arxiv-2309-04159.title: Anti-phase synchronization in a population of swarmalators
arxiv-2309-04159.creator: Samali Ghosh, Gourab Kumar Sar, Soumen Majhi, Dibakar Ghosh
arxiv-2309-04159.description: Abstract (Received XX MONTH XX; accepted XX MONTH XX; published XX MONTH XX) Swarmalators are oscillatory systems endowed with a spatial component, whose spatial and phase dynamics affect each other. Such systems can demonstrate fascinating collective dynamics resembling many real-world processes. Through this work, we study a population of swarmalators where they are divided into different communities.

arxiv-2312-07172.title: Channel assisted noise propagation in a two-step cascade
arxiv-2312-07172.creator: Mintu Nandi, Sudip Chattopadhyay, Somshubhro Bandyopadhyay, Suman K Banik
arxiv-2312-07172.description: Abstract Signal propagation in biochemical networks is characterized by the inherent randomness in gene expression and fluctuations of the environmental components, commonly known as intrinsic and extrinsic noise, respectively. We present a theoretical framework for noise propagation in a generic two-step cascade (S → \rightarrow X → \rightarrow Y) regarding intrinsic and extrinsic noise.

arxiv-2405-10078.title: Spurious reconstruction from brain activity Journal: Neural Networks
arxiv-2405-10078.creator: Ken Shirakawa, Yoshihiro Nagano, Misato Tanaka, Shuntaro C. Aoki, Yusuke Muraki, Kei Majima, Yukiyasu Kamitani
arxiv-2405-10078.description: Abstract Advances in brain decoding, particularly in visual image reconstruction, have sparked discussions about the societal implications and ethical considerations of neurotechnology. As reconstruction methods aim to recover visual experiences from brain activity and achieve prediction beyond training samples (zero-shot prediction), it is crucial to assess their capabilities and limitations to inform public expectations and regulations.

arxiv-2408-09594.title: Moonshine: Distilling Game Content Generators into Steerable Generative Models
arxiv-2408-09594.creator: Yuhe Nie, Michael Middleton, Tim Merino Nidhushan Kanagaraja Ashutosh Kumar, Zhan Zhuang Julian Togelius
arxiv-2408-09594.description: Abstract Procedural Content Generation via Machine Learning (PCGML) has enhanced game content creation, yet challenges in controllability and limited training data persist. This study addresses these issues by distilling a constructive PCG algorithm into a controllable PCGML model. We first generate a large amount of content with a constructive algorithm and label it using a Large Language Model (LLM).

arxiv-2410-14050.title: Learning Multimodal Cues of Children’s Uncertainty
arxiv-2410-14050.creator: Qi Cheng *, Mert İnan *, Rahma Mbarki *, Grace Grmek *, Theresa Choi *, Yiming Sun, Kimele Persaud, Jenny Wang, Malihe Alikhani
arxiv-2410-14050.description: Abstract Understanding uncertainty plays a critical role in achieving common ground Clark et al. (1983) . This is especially important for multimodal AI systems that collaborate with users to solve a problem or guide the user through a challenging concept.

arxiv-2503-18792.title: REALM: A Dataset of Real-World LLM Use Cases
arxiv-2503-18792.creator: Jingwen Cheng, Kshitish Ghate, Wenyue Hua, William Yang Wang, Hong Shen, Fei Fang
arxiv-2503-18792.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs), such as the GPT series, have driven significant industrial applications, leading to economic and societal transformations. However, a comprehensive understanding of their real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce REALM , a dataset of over 94,000 LLM use cases collected from Reddit and news articles.

arxiv-2504-01447.title: What KM3-230213A events may tell us about the neutrino mass and dark matter
arxiv-2504-01447.creator: Basabendu Barman, Arindam Das, Prantik Sarmah
arxiv-2504-01447.description: Abstract Within the framework of general U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) scenario, we demonstrate that the ultra high energy neutrinos recently detected by KM3NeT could originate from a decaying right handed neutrino dark matter (DM), with a mass of 440 PeV.

arxiv-2504-11507.title: Morphologic Evolution in Simulated Wood Densification
arxiv-2504-11507.creator: Alessia Ferrara, Júlio O. Amando de Barros, Sophie Marie Koch, Falk K. Wittel
arxiv-2504-11507.description: Abstract This study investigates the radial densification of spruce wood using explicit Finite Element Method simulations, focusing on the effects of various densification protocols. These protocols include quasi-static compression, oscillatory excitation, and self-densification through shrinking hydrogel fillings and their impact on the morphogenesis of folding patterns across different tissue types.

arxiv-2511-04679.title: GentleHumanoid: Learning Upper-body Compliance for Contact-rich Human and Object Interaction
arxiv-2511-04679.creator: Qingzhou Lu, Yao Feng, Baiyu Shi, Michael Piseno, Zhenan Bao, C. Karen Liu Stanford University
arxiv-2511-04679.description: Abstract † † footnotetext: ∗ Equal contribution. This work was done during Qingzhou Lu’s internship at Stanford University. Qingzhou is now with Tsinghua University. Humanoid robots are expected to operate in human-centered environments where safe and natural physical interaction is essential. However, most recent reinforcement learning (RL) policies emphasize rigid tracking and suppress external forces.

arxiv-2601-13569.title: DRGW: Learning Disentangled Representations for Robust Graph Watermarking
arxiv-2601-13569.creator: Jiasen Li, Yanwei Liu, Zhuoyi Shang, Xiaoyan Gu, Weiping Wang
arxiv-2601-13569.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jiasen Li, Yanwei Liu, Zhuoyi Shang, Xiaoyan Gu, Weiping Wang. Graph-structured data is foundational to numerous web applications, and watermarking is crucial for protecting their intellectual property and ensuring data provenance. Existing watermarking methods primarily operate on graph structures or entangled graph representations, which compromise the transparency and robustness of watermarks due to the information coupling in representing graphs and uncontrollable discretization in transforming continuous numerical representations into graph structures.

pmc-10752177.title: Validation of the Angle Bisector Method for Precise Tibiofibular Syndesmosis Fixation Angle Using Computed Tomography and 3D-Printed Models
pmc-10752177.creator: Bedri Karaismailoglu, Davut Yerlikaya, Ceren Özdemir, Kubra Dalbudak, Tolga Barkan Komurcu, Musa Batuhan Yolcu, Arin Celayir, Erdem Sahin, Mehmed Nuri Tutuncu, Mustafa Kara
pmc-10752177.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Category:Ankle; TraumaIntroduction/Purpose:The proposed ideal alignment for the syndesmosis involves a line connecting the centroids of the fibula and tibia, but there is uncertainty about the optimal intraoperative method for determining the appropriate fixation angle. This is due to the fact that the AO guidelines do not account for patient or level-specific factors, and the determination of the angle relative to the coronal plane relies on the surgeon's judgment. Inexperienced trauma surgeons may encounter significant problems with syndesmotic malalignment as a result.

pmc-11506041.title: Plant‐Based Anticancer Compounds With a Focus on Breast Cancer
pmc-11506041.creator: Amin Moradi Hasan‐Abad, Amir Atapour, Ali Sobhani‐Nasab, Hossein Motedayyen, Reza ArefNezhad
pmc-11506041.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Breast cancer is a common form of cancer among women characterized by the growth of malignant cells in the breast tissue. The most common treatments for this condition include chemotherapy, surgical intervention, radiation therapy, hormone therapy, and biological therapy. The primary issues associated with chemotherapy and radiation therapy are their adverse events and significant financial burden among patients in underdeveloped countries. This highlights the need to explore and develop superior therapeutic options that are less detrimental and more economically efficient.

pmc-11533889.title: Acupuncture and Moxibustion in the Treatment of Gynecological Perioperative Anxiety: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11533889.creator: Xiu Wang, Qianqian Yu, Jun Zhu, Junlan Liu, Xuyuan Gao, Xiudie Wang, Lanlan Wang, Xia Xu
pmc-11533889.description: ObjectiveThis systematic review and meta-analysis aims to investigate the effectiveness and safety of acupuncture and moxibustion in managing perioperative anxiety during gynecological surgery.MethodsRelevant studies published from the establishment of the databases to March 20, 2023, were searched in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, and CBM.

pmc-12388868.creator: Veronika Zemanová, Milan Pavlík, Milan Novák, Daniela Pavlíková, Carmen Arena
pmc-12388868.description: As chemical messengers, phytohormones can enhance the tolerance of plants to stress caused by toxic elements (TEs) such as cadmium (Cd), lead (Pb), and zinc (Zn). This study investigated the combined toxicity of Cd, Pb, and Zn, and its impact on stress phytohormones (jasmonates, salicylic acid, and abscisic acid), in oat (Avena sativa L.

pmc-12588750.title: Schistosomiasis and Intestinal Helminthiases in a Remote Area of Central Madagascar
pmc-12588750.creator: Gabriela Tapia-Veloz, Mónica Gozalbo, Elena Domingo, Danielle Aurore Doll Rakoto, Yeseul Kang, M. Teresa Galán-Puchades, Màrius V. Fuentes, María Trelis
pmc-12588750.description: BackgroundSchistosomiasis and intestinal helminthiases are significant public health issues that severely impact the development of children and adolescents in impoverished regions, such as the rural village of Soavinarivo in central Madagascar. These issues are often associated with deficient hygienic and sanitary conditions.MethodsA prospective cross-sectional study was conducted in October 2017 on children aged 3–15 years.

pmc-12627147.title: Supplementing Program Profiles in Evidence Clearinghouses with Insights for Practice: a Qualitative Investigation of Application to Youth Mentoring Programs in CrimeSolutions
pmc-12627147.creator: Aisha N Griffith, Julia Pryce, David L DuBois, Timothy Brezina, Kelly E Stewart, Michael Garringer
pmc-12627147.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Evidence-based program repositories have been designed to help practitioners in their decision-making. Most repositories supplement summaries of effectiveness evidence with information intended to assist with implementation of each included program (e.g., training costs). It is less common for guidance to be included to support translation of findings for a broader range of purposes, such as enhancing related programs already in place.

pmc-12639562.title: Structural, physicochemical, and gel properties of Wencheng yam (Dioscorea alata L.) starch and its application for enhancing set-type yogurt properties
pmc-12639562.creator: Ahmed K Rashwan, Fanrui Zhou, Amged El-Harairy, Wei Chen
pmc-12639562.description: The purpose of this study was to characterize yam starch (YS) and its effect on set-type yogurt (STY) properties. The YS yield was 13.05 ± 1.22 % and it contained 24.6 ± 1.21 % amylose and 75.4 ± 1.21 % amylopectin, which provides gelling and stabilizing properties to the STY.

pmc-12743674.title: Functional outcomes of one-, two- and three-lobe technique in anatomical endoscopic enucleation for benign prostatic obstruction: a systematic review and network-meta-analysis
pmc-12743674.creator: Oswald David, Sieberer Manuela, Ramesmayer Christian, Deininger Susanne, Pallauf Maximilian, Enikeev Dmitry, Herrmann Thomas, Sountoulides Petros, Lusuardi Lukas
pmc-12743674.description: IntroductionBenign prostatic obstruction (BPO) is a common condition. Anatomical endoscopic enucleation of the prostate (EEP) is the mainstay in therapy for large glands (> 80 ml), but also feasible in smaller prostates. The original three-lobe enucleation technique has been supplemented by two-lobe and one-lobe or en-bloc techniques.

pmc-13275181.title: The Long‐Term Quality of Life Study for Patients Received Chest Wall Reconstruction by Using 3D‐Printed PEEK Implants
pmc-13275181.creator: Ge Li, Xiao Liang, Xing Li, Yangfan Huo, Minghai Ma, Yuanquan Zhang, Minglei Zhuo, Lei Wang
pmc-13275181.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundFor the repair of chest wall defects, three‐dimensional‐printed PEEK implants show great potential due to their excellent anatomical matching and mechanical properties. However, Quality‐Of‐Life assessments after using these implants in chest wall reconstruction remain underexplored.MethodsA retrospective cohort study included 20 patients who underwent chest wall defect reconstruction with 3D‐printed PEEK implants at our center between April 2017 and June 2024 and were followed up long‐term.

pmc-13562478.title: Cellulolytic potential of bacteria isolated from Australian marsupial herbivores
pmc-13562478.creator: Kaniz Fatema, Md Mezbaul Bahar, Mallavarapu Megharaj
pmc-13562478.description: Cellulose, the most abundant renewable biopolymer on Earth, represents a key resource for biofuel production but requires efficient enzymatic hydrolysis to overcome its structural resistance. In this study, cellulose-degrading bacteria were isolated from fecal samples of two Australian marsupial herbivores: the koala (Phascolarctos cinereus) and the common wombat (Vombatus ursinus).
